definitions.short: Nahalal or Nahalol , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H5096. Nahalal or Nahalol II. נַהֲלֹל proper name, of a location Judg 1:30 in Zebulun, ᵐ5 Δωμανα , A Εναμμαν , ᵐ5 L Αμμαν ; = נַהֲלָל Josh 19:15 ; 21:35 , ᵐ5 Ναβααλ , Νααλωλ , ᵐ5 L Αναλωθ , Αλωμ ; — site unknown, compare GFM Judg 1:30 .

occurrences.englishText: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.
Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
